retired_gates.dust_grain_std_ratio: Compared a procedural dust-density field with its smoothed control. Dust is now in the complete generated top image.
retired_gates.broad_face_island_max_m: Measured placed blister instances; there are no placed islands in the image-owned layout.
retired_gates.unattached_runoff_max: Measured the removed analytic runoff control texture; new supplementary stains are baked at bounded opacity.
retired_gates.streak_width_median_m: Measured half-opacity contours of the removed full-opacity analytic generator.
retired_gates.streak_source_length_range_m: Preset source lengths no longer decide the corrosion layout.
retired_gates.streak_reduced_opacity_max: Replaced the old less-than-one generator opacity by the explicit <=0.30 limit.
retired_gates.panel_edge_rust_cv_min: Measured variability of the old procedural edge band, replaced by independently measured image edge/broad rust ratios.
retired_gates.fasteners_with_streaks, visible_fastener: The old >=50% population of strong 40 mm generated trails required a stamped fixture distribution and >=0.03 contrast. Image-owned trails and optional <=30% stains replace that generator contract; connected-run measurements remain diagnostics, not passes.
retired_gates.dust_linear_difference_{albedo,neutral,p: The old control disabled a separate dust mask while retaining identical substrate. Dust is now part of the top image. A generated dust-removal edit is illustrative and is not a numerically matched effect-disabled control; differences remain diagnostics, not visibility passes.

replaced_gates.swatch colour and correlation: Same thresholds, measured on every complete face image against its own saved crop
replaced_gates.edge/broad >=2.5: Replaced by the requested >=1.8 on every painted face and all lighting lanes
